verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents sub-workflows, a way for one workflow to invoke another, or user-authored private modules shared across workflows. The closest items are pre-built source-available components, contributing new components to the public registry via GitHub PR, and CLI deployment of event sources. These are adjacent features, not reusable sub-workflows that other workflows call.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose reusable sub-workflows or modules that other workflows call
